official.deadline_note: No application deadline exists for this scholarship: there is no separate application and no closing date. The scholarship is assessed automatically when the student applies for admission, and applies to students who receive an offer and commence study in 2027 or later (Trimester 1 2027 and beyond).
official.application_cycle: International Excellence Scholarship 2027 - for new international students who receive an offer and commence study in 2027 or later (Trimester 1, 2027 and beyond)
official.status_note: The official page publishes the International Excellence Scholarship 2027, established to attract high-performing students and awarded to applicants who receive an offer to study in an eligible program and commence study with the University in 2027. Students commencing in 2026 (including Trimester 3 2026) or earlier remain under the Terms and Conditions attached to their original offer letter.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Annual Value: 'A dollar value equivalent to 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee.' Unit Value (based on 10 units): 'A dollar value equivalent to 20% of the gross unit value variable based on program of study.' The scholarship is administered for each term of study in the eligible program(s) as 'a tuition fee reduction' against the number of units required to complete the program.
benefits: Annual value: a dollar value equivalent to 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee
Unit value (based on 10 units): a dollar value equivalent to 20% of the gross unit value, variable based on program of study
Applied for each term of study in the eligible program(s) as a tuition fee reduction against the number of units required to successfully complete the program
The benefit amount is calculated against the number of units the recipient is enrolled in at Census date for each term, provided the conditions of the scholarship are maintained
eligibility: Be an international full fee-paying student
Be commencing study in an eligible CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree program at the University
Not be the beneficiary of a separate University scholarship unless prior approval for special dispensation has been obtained from the university
Be able to meet the financial obligations of a full fee-paying international student specified by the Australian Government (evidence must be provided if requested by the university)
Not be enrolled in a program of study covered under a quota arrangement in which the number of international enrolments are limited
Reside within 50km of the campus location specified on your Confirmation of Enrolment (COE)
requirements: Remain an international student enrolled in an eligible program
Maintain the conditions of the scholarship for the fee waiver to be applied each term
Reside within 50km of the campus location specified on the Confirmation of Enrolment (COE)
documents: None required for the scholarship itself - required documents will be listed on the 'Your Documents' page of your application
The application portal accepts PDF only, with a maximum of 3 PDFs smaller than 5 MB per document type upload field
selection_criteria: Scholarship offers are made based on eligibility, aligned to the University's published entry and eligibility requirements and made at the absolute discretion of the University
Some students may not be eligible for an offer even if criteria are met

Per the University's international scholarships page, students ineligible for the 30% Vice-Chancellor's International Academic Merit Scholarship, or where scholarship slots have been filled, are assessed for the 20% International Excellence Scholarship
coverage: 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee, applied as a tuition fee reduction each term on a pro-rata basis

Apportioned over each course taken, taking into consideration approved reduced study load arrangements, credit exemptions, recognition of prior learning awards, progression or partial-year program enrolments
Calculated against the number of units enrolled in at Census date for each term
Living costs, accommodation and travel are not covered
application_method: No application is required for this scholarship
Scholarships are automatically assessed upon application for admission to the University
Eligible students receive notification of the value of the scholarship within the Letter of Offer
To reject an offer of scholarship, it is the student's responsibility to inform the University
official.application_route: No separate scholarship application - apply for admission to an eligible CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree; the scholarship is assessed automatically and the value is notified in the Letter of Offer
official.study_mode: Full-time (benefit is defined against a standard full-time study load of 80 units and applied pro-rata for approved reduced study loads)
official.citizenship_residency: International (full fee-paying) students only; recipients must reside within 50km of the campus location specified on the Confirmation of Enrolment (COE)
official.international_eligibility: Open only to international students - the scholarship is restricted to international full fee-paying students
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Must be commencing an eligible CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree program. Excluded: English Language Bridging Program (ELBP), Enabling, Non-Award, Exchange or Study Abroad programs, Higher Degrees by Research programs, degrees without a CRICOS code, standalone Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma programs, programs delivered at offshore campuses or via online delivery, students in quota-limited programs, internal transfer students at an Australian campus, students transferring from the University's Singapore campus, students sponsored by an external entity, and recipients of Australia Awards scholarships. Colleges: Engineering, Science and Environment; Health, Medicine and Wellbeing; Human and Social Futures.
official.duration: Ongoing for each term of study in the eligible program(s), provided the conditions of the scholarship are maintained; annual value is set under a standard full-time study load (80 units)
official.description: The International Excellence Scholarship 2027 has been established to attract high-performing students to study at the University of Newcastle, acknowledging applicants with a strong academic background and providing an ongoing incentive for continued academic achievement. It is awarded to applicants who receive an offer to study in an eligible program and commence study with the University in 2027 or later.

exact dollar amount - the official pages publish the benefit only as 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee, a variable value that differs by program of study, so no fixed dollar figure exists to record

verification.notes: Amount (20% of gross annual international tuition fee for students commencing in 2027), benefit structure, eligibility, exclusions and the automatic-assessment selection process were confirmed on the official UNI_053 scholarship page; the no-application route and 2027-plus commencement were corroborated on the University's official International Scholarships hub page. The official 2027 Terms and Conditions PDF is referenced by both pages but its direct download is Cloudflare-protected (403) on repeated attempts; its linked content was not independently parsed.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic tuition discount, not a scholarship you apply for: submit your admission application for an eligible CRICOS-registered coursework degree and the 20% fee reduction is assessed alongside it, with the value confirmed in your Letter of Offer. It trims 20% off your tuition for every term you keep meeting the conditions, but you still fund the remaining 80% yourself, along with all living, accommodation and travel costs. Because eligibility is tied to the campus named on your Confirmation of Enrolment and a 50 km residence zone, pick your campus and housing deliberately before you accept the offer. Check too whether you qualify for the higher-tier 30% Vice-Chancellor's scholarship or the $1,500 Global Access Grant, since holding a separate University scholarship without dispensation would disqualify you.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International full fee-paying students starting an eligible on-campus coursework degree at the University of Newcastle in 2027 who can live within 50 km of their COE campus and hold no other University scholarship.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your intended program is a CRICOS-registered undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree - not HDR, ELBP, enabling, non-award, exchange, study abroad, a standalone graduate certificate or diploma, or an offshore/online delivery
Budget the remaining 80% of international tuition plus living costs, accommodation, flights and visa costs, none of which the waiver covers
Prepare evidence that you can meet the Australian Government's financial obligations for a full fee-paying student, in case the University requests it
Check the program is not quota-limited for international enrolments before relying on the scholarship
Fix your intended address relative to the campus on your COE so the 50 km rule is satisfied from day one
If you hold or are pursuing another University scholarship, obtain written special dispensation before assuming you can keep both
common_rejection_risks: Falling into an excluded category - quota-limited program, HDR, ELBP/enabling/non-award/exchange/study abroad, standalone graduate certificate or diploma, offshore or online delivery, or a degree with no CRICOS code
Already holding another University scholarship without prior special dispensation
Being an internal transfer student at an Australian campus, transferring from the Singapore campus, being sponsored by an external entity, or holding an Australia Award
Scholarship slots simply being filled - the University states some students may not be offered it even when criteria are met, and the 500 places are indicative only
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 80% of international tuition fees for the whole program, plus all living costs, accommodation, flights and visa expenses - the waiver covers tuition only and nothing else
document_audit: No scholarship-specific documents are required; anything needed is listed on the 'Your Documents' page of your admission application
Upload limits are strict: PDF only, maximum 3 PDFs under 5 MB per document type field
If the University queries financial capacity, you must provide evidence of meeting the Australian Government's financial obligations for a full fee-paying international student
Keep the Letter of Offer - it is the only place your scholarship value is notified before enrolment
alerts: The waiver will not appear on your tuition account until after Census date - the University explicitly warns not to delay your tuition payment waiting for it, and asks you to pay tuition minus the expected scholarship amount by the due date
The benefit is recalculated each term against your enrolment at Census date, so a reduced study load, credit or RPL, progression or partial-year enrolment shrinks it pro-rata
The 50 km residence rule is enforced against the campus on your COE - moving further away or switching campus breaks eligibility
The number of scholarships is indicative (about 500) and the University reserves the right not to award; there is no application you can submit to improve your odds
Rejecting the scholarship is your responsibility to notify - silence means acceptance
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit an international admission application through the University's admissions system; screening is automatic, with the outcome delivered inside the Letter of Offer - there is no separate scholarship submission to manage.
